summary: One Secure Agility camera (383) covers 8 zones at the Cooks to Cove Greenway / Marion St intersection from 29 Dec 2025. Until 9 Mar 2026 each zone reported both directions of travel as two records under one DIRECTION_SK. The automatic duplicate fixes wrongly halved these counts, so the raw values are restored and the direction split is marked unreliable. Apart from that, the 27 Jan catch-up dump (rightly removed) and a probable misclassification burst at site 574 on 29 Aug, the data after March is clean and stable.
